comments.dev_dependencies: The test runners (tests/unit-tests.js, tests/deploy-test.js) execute node <root>/node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js, so the Jest toolchain must be declared HERE - pnpm only links a package's own dependencies into its node_modules, never a workspace member's
comments.do_not_remove: Removing this breaks dependency sharing and leaves the test runners with no resolvable Jest
comments.shared_deps: Every service package and the tests package below this root share this root's node_modules
comments.workspace: This package.json plus pnpm-workspace.yaml make the project root a pnpm workspace
